evidence.quote: First state that there is one protagonist, then state that this same protagonist appears simultaneously as five different-looking people who talk to each other.

criteria.issue: Subject identity, count, and appearance are inconsistently defined and impossible to maintain. The prompt states one protagonist who simultaneously appears as five different-looking people, violating identity stability and count consistency.
criteria.rationale: The prompt creates a logical contradiction: a single protagonist cannot simultaneously exist as five distinct individuals without violating identity and count consistency. This is a major internal inconsistency.

evidence.quote: Replace the whole video with a looping snowy landscape with no characters and no plot. ... First state that there is one protagonist, then state that this same protagonist appears simultaneously as five different-looking people who talk to each other.

criteria.issue: Actions are incoherent and causally disconnected. The prompt demands a looping snowy landscape with no plot, then introduces talking characters, a soccer celebration, and contradictory sensory descriptions, creating a dangling and incompatible sequence.
criteria.rationale: The narrative actions are mutually exclusive and causally unconnected. A plotless snowy landscape cannot coexist with talking characters or a soccer celebration without a coherent causal progression, resulting in a major inconsistency.

evidence.quote: Reverse the timeline: show the ending first, then cut to a beginning that does not match. ... Set the total runtime to 2 seconds, while also making every shot last 19 seconds.

criteria.issue: Chronology is impossible. The prompt requires reversing the timeline (showing ending first), then cutting to a non-matching beginning, while also setting total runtime to 2 seconds and every shot to 19 seconds — a mathematical impossibility.
criteria.rationale: A 2-second video cannot contain any shot lasting 19 seconds. This is a fundamental temporal contradiction, making the timeline infeasible and thus a major inconsistency.

evidence.quote: Describe that same moment as harsh noon sun and as a lightless night, and as both a locked camera and a camera that never stops shaking.

criteria.issue: Spatial consistency is violated. The prompt demands showing the same moment as both harsh noon sun and lightless night, and as both a locked camera and a shaking camera — impossible coexisting spatial and sensory conditions.
criteria.rationale: The same moment cannot simultaneously have contradictory lighting (noon vs. night) and camera motion (locked vs. shaking). This violates spatial and sensory consistency, constituting a major inconsistency.

evidence.quote: Ignore the person, clothing, pose, and setting in the first frame, and replace them with a stranger of the opposite age and gender in a white studio.

criteria.issue: Physics and object permanence are violated. The prompt requires replacing the first frame’s subject with a stranger of opposite age and gender in a white studio, while also ignoring the original setting — creating an impossible state transition.
criteria.rationale: The prompt demands an instantaneous, unexplained replacement of a subject and setting without any causal or physical transition, violating object permanence and real-world physics, which is a major inconsistency.

evidence.quote: Describe that same moment as harsh noon sun and as a lightless night, and as both a locked camera and a camera that never stops shaking.

criteria.issue: Audio-visual synchronization is impossible. The prompt requires describing the same moment with contradictory lighting and camera motion, which would misalign with any audio or visual cues, creating sensory dissonance.
criteria.rationale: The same moment cannot have conflicting visual conditions (lighting, camera motion) without creating misaligned sensory experiences. This violates AVS consistency, resulting in a major issue.

summary: The enhanced prompt contains severe internal inconsistencies across all criteria. It explicitly contradicts the original prompt and evidence, introduces impossible conditions (e.g., 19-second shots in a 2-second video), and violates fundamental logic in subject identity, chronology, physics, and sensory alignment. The prompt is self-contradictory and incoherent, rendering the entire narrative structure invalid.
